strategy: first-run continuous outdoor full-clear baseline; structural exclusions only; no pre-run economic pruning

entry_contract.carried_in_quest_name: 前往征服堡，自求多福吧！

dependency_rows.name: 征服斗兽场：疯狂的熊怪
征服斗兽场：鲜血与金属
前往征服堡，自求多福吧！

route_mechanism_notes.name: 休尼克的掩饰
route_mechanism_notes.note: 《休尼克的掩饰》需要1份煤块和5份面粉；两者都可在征服堡内向商人购买。Questie物品来源展开会把煤块的全世界掉落源带入route_zones，不能因此误判为副本任务。

tasks.name: 巨石横飞
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在丘陵上俯瞰索尔莫丹的库伦要求你向索尔莫丹的露天区域投掷石块，以此骚扰铁矮人的挖掘工作。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan wants you to disrupt the iron dwarves' work by throwing boulders into the exposed area of Thor Modan.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 抓巨魔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 岩石之泉的萨米尔希望你对被巴德打昏的达卡莱巨魔使用赏金猎人的笼子。
tasks.objective_text_en: Samir at Granite Springs wants you to use the Bounty Hunter's Cage on a drakkari troll that's been stunned by Budd.

extra_objectives.text: Enlist Budd's help
Escort Budd to the Drak'Zin Ruins
Use Budd's Tag Troll spell to stun Drakkari trolls
Capture stunned Drakkari trolls with Bounty Hunter's Cage

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 攻破防线
tasks.objective_text_zh: 库伦要你杀死指挥官阿格鲁姆，然后返回鸟瞰索尔莫丹的小山坡向他复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan wants you to kill Iron Thane Argrum.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 停战？
tasks.objective_text_zh: 岩石之泉的达库鲁希望你在他的笼子附近使用钝刻刀，然后和他对话。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru at Granite Springs wants you to use the Dull Carving Knife near his cage and then speak to him.

extra_objectives.text: Use the Dull Carving Knife near Drakuru

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 幻象之瓶
tasks.objective_text_zh: 岩石之泉的达库鲁希望你把一只灌魔之瓶、一片水草叶和3片薄雾叶交给他。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru at Granite Springs wants you to bring him an Imbued Vial, a Waterweed Frond, and 3 Haze Leaves.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 解读象形文字
tasks.objective_text_zh: 达库鲁希望你从达克辛废墟的达卡莱巨魔身上获取5份冰冻魔精，然后在达库鲁的火盆处使用他的药剂。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru wants you to get 5 Frozen Mojo from the Drakkari Trolls at the Ruins of Drak'Zin and then use the elixir at Drakuru's Brazier there.

extra_objectives.text: Drink Drakuru's Elixir after gathering 5 Frozen Mojo

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 必要的牺牲
tasks.objective_text_zh: 达库鲁希望你前往塞布哈拉克，找到他的火盆，并将预言者之眼交给他。 /  / 你需要取得督军希姆波的魔精，才能在那里使用达库鲁的药剂。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru wants you to bring the Eye of the Prophets to him at Drakuru's Brazier in Zeb'Halak. /  / You will need to collect Zim'bo's Mojo to use Drakuru's Elixir there.

extra_objectives.text: Drink Drakuru's Elixir after gathering Zim'bo's Mojo

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 破损的日记
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集8张遗失的日记书页，将它们与不完整的日记合并，然后将完整的日记交给欧尼瓦营地的先知帕鲁纳。
tasks.objective_text_en: Recover 8 Missing Journal Pages, combine them with the Incomplete Journal, and return the completed journal to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 净化天灾巨魔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 岩石之泉的马克希望你在达克萨隆用他的烈酒净化20个饥饿的天灾巨魔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Mack at Granite Springs wants you to use his grog to burn 20 Famished Scourge Trolls at Drak'Tharon.

sources.name: 惊骇的达卡莱萨满祭司

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 古树精华宝石
tasks.objective_text_zh: 达库鲁希望你前往蓝天伐木场的最上层房间，在一个地精的尸体附近找到古树精华宝石。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru wants you to go to the uppermost chamber at Blue Sky Logging Ground and find the Heart of the Ancients.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 翻译日记
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将一小株灵息草交给欧尼瓦营地的先知帕鲁纳。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring a sprig of Spiritsbreath to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 符文中的预言
tasks.objective_text_zh: 欧尼瓦营地的先知帕鲁纳要求你解读出三块符文板上的文字。
tasks.objective_text_en: Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah wants you to decipher the three Rune Plates.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 灰尘之声
tasks.objective_text_zh: 达库鲁希望你在达基尔金废墟中找到达卡莱石板，并从达卡莱先知和达卡莱保卫者身上收集5份神圣魔精。然后在废墟中达库鲁的火盆上使用达库鲁的药剂，召唤出他的影像。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru wants you to collect the Drakkari Tablets from the Ruins of Drakil'jin and 5 Sacred Mojo from Drakkari Oracles and Protectors there. You are then to use Drakuru's Elixir at Drakuru's Brazier at the ruins to summon his image.

extra_objectives.text: Drink Drakuru's Elixir after gathering 5 Sacred Mojo

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 鼓舞士气
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用大地碎片鼓舞巨石丘陵的灰熊丘陵巨人，杀死所有与你交战的铁矮人，然后回到俯瞰索尔莫丹的丘陵地带，向库伦复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Shard of the Earth to rally the Grizzly Hills Giants fighting in the Boulder Hills, kill any iron dwarves who oppose you, then report to Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: “钢铁之子”
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死10名守卫索尔莫丹的铁矮人，然后向欧尼瓦营地的斥候沃塔肯复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill any 10 Iron Dwarves defending Thor Modan and report back to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 新的盟友
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往俯瞰索尔莫丹的丘陵地带，在那里找到库伦。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 加弗洛克
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与泰塞斯废墟内的加弗洛克谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Gavrock at the Ruins of Tethys.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 喔——哒！！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 护送哈里森离开达基尔金废墟，然后与哈考尔营地的哈考尔谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Escort Harrison from Drakil'jin Ruins, then speak with Harkor at Harkor's Camp.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 压制符文
tasks.objective_text_zh: 泰塞斯废墟内的加弗洛克要求你通过击败工头多瓦尔、工头库尔甘、工头洛克里和工头布隆诺的方式中和全部四处压制符文。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gavrock, at the Ruins of Tethys, wants you to neutralize the four Runes of Compulsion by defeating Overseer Durval, Overseer Korgan, Overseer Lochli, and Overseer Brunon.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 潜在的能量
tasks.objective_text_zh: 分别在第一块远古巨石、第二块远古巨石和第三块远古巨石为加弗洛克碎片充能，然后向泰塞斯废墟内的加弗洛克复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Charge the Shard of Gavrock at the First Ancient Stone, the Second Ancient Stone, and the Third Ancient Stone, then return to Gavrock at the Ruins of Tethys.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 终获解救
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用加弗洛克的符文碎裂之石解救4名符文巨人，然后向泰塞斯废墟内的加弗洛克复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use Gavrock's Runebreaker to free 4 Runed Giants, then return to Gavrock at the Ruins of Tethys.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 等肉下锅
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈考尔营地的哈考尔希望你能帮他从暗嚎徘徊者身上收集10块多汁的座狼肉，从厚蹄食草鹿身上收集10块铲角肉排。
tasks.objective_text_en: Harkor at Harkor's Camp wants you to collect 10 pieces of Fibrous Worg Meat from Duskhowl Prowlers and 10 Shovelhorn Steaks from Longhoof Grazers.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 心灵的创伤
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈考尔营地的哈考尔要你在达基尔金废墟外面杀死10个达卡莱保卫者和10个达卡莱先知。
tasks.objective_text_en: Harkor at Harkor's Camp wants you to kill 10 Drakkari Protectors and 10 Drakkari Oracles outside Drakil'jin Ruins.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 孤胆英雄……
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈考尔营地的克拉斯要你进入达基尔金废墟，收集5只达卡莱之罐。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to enter Drakil'jin Ruins and collect 5 Drakkari Canopic Jars.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 达卡古尔之槌
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈考尔营地的克拉斯希望你去杀死达基尔金废墟外的达卡古尔，然后把达基尔金之槌交给他。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to slay Drak'aguul outside Drakil'jin Ruins and return with the Drakil'jin Mallet.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 死后相见
tasks.english_name: See You on the Other Side
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈考尔营地的克拉斯希望你使用达基尔金之槌敲响达基尔金废墟外的锣。等你被杀死以后，以灵魂形态进入废墟，与甘休的灵魂交谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to use the Drakil'jin Mallet on the gongs outside Drakil'jin Ruins. Once you have been slain, you are to enter the ruins and speak with the spirit of Gan'jo while you are dead.

extra_objectives.text: Ring the gong outside Drakil'jin to summon Warlord Jin'arrak

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 萨莎的狩猎
tasks.objective_text_zh: 萨莎要求你在冬至村中击败12名冬至村猎人。
tasks.objective_text_en: Sasha wants you to kill 12 Solstice Hunters in Solstice Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 冷静一下，伙计
tasks.objective_text_zh: 甘休希望你能从他在达基尔金废墟的箱子里拿到永恒休眠之雪。 /  / 对那里的上古阿卡莱幽魂使用永恒休眠之雪，然后把它们的达卡莱灵魂微粒交给哈考尔营地的克拉斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gan'jo wants you to collect the Snow of Eternal Slumber from his chest in the Drakil'jin Ruins. /  / You are to use the Snow on the Ancient Drakkari Spirits there and take their Drakkari Spirit Particles back to Kraz at Harkor's Camp.

extra_objectives.text: Speak with Gan'jo to return to life
Use the Snow of Eternal Slumber on ancient Drakkari spirits

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 金亚拉克的末日
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈考尔营地的克拉斯希望你从达基尔金废墟收集神圣达卡莱供品，然后将达卡莱灵魂之尘撒在上面。你必须在达基尔金废墟的锣处使用灌注能量的达卡莱供品。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to collect the Sacred Drakkari Offering from the Drakil'jin Ruins and use the Drakkari Spirit Dust on it. You must use the Infused Drakkari Offering at the gongs outside of Drakil'jin Ruins.

extra_objectives.text: Place the Infused Drakkari Offering at the gongs outside Drakil'jin

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 狼人的末日
tasks.objective_text_zh: 白松商栈的萨莎要求你前往血月岛，杀死塞拉斯、瓦拉姆、污血之喉和阿鲁高之影。
tasks.objective_text_en: Sasha at the White Pine Trading Post wants you to go to Bloodmoon Isle and slay Selas, Varlam, Goremaw and the Shade of Arugal.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 有趣的计划
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将完整的作战魔像蓝图交给欧尼瓦营地的勘探员罗卡尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the completed War Golem Blueprints to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 灰狼的毛皮
tasks.objective_text_zh: 征服堡的皮货商人休尼克希望你能从北面森林的灰雾捕猎者身上获取3张灰色座狼皮。
tasks.objective_text_en: Hidetrader Jun'ik in Conquest Hold wants you to get 3 Gray Worg Hides from Graymist Hunters in the woods to the north.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 替代品
tasks.objective_text_zh: 皮货商人休尼克希望你能交给他6张灰熊皮。
tasks.objective_text_en: Hidetrader Jun'ik wants you to bring him 6 Grizzly Hides.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 休尼克的掩饰
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将1份煤块和5份面粉交给灰熊丘陵征服堡的皮货商人休尼克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 1 piece of Coal and 5 Simple Flour to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 《休尼克的掩饰》需要1份煤块和5份面粉；两者都可在征服堡内向商人购买。Questie物品来源展开会把煤块的全世界掉落源带入route_zones，不能因此误判为副本任务。

tasks.name: 给克雷娜送货
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将一捆兽皮交给征服堡的克雷娜。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Bundle of Hides to Krenna in Conquest Hold.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 跟我的小朋友打招呼
tasks.english_name: Say Hello to My Little Friend
tasks.objective_text_zh: 普雷蒙希望你将哈考尔的调料的交给哈考尔营地的哈考尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Prigmon wants you to bring Harkor's Ingredients to Harkor at Harkor's Camp.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 不速之“客”
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将5根成熟的雄鹿角交给欧尼瓦营地的托尔玛克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 5 Mature Stag Horns to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 收集零件
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将8个作战魔像零件交给欧尼瓦营地的勘探员罗卡尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 8 War Golem Parts to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 我们有能源
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将杜拉尔的能量晶格和卡索恩的能量晶格交给欧尼瓦营地的勘探员罗卡尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Durar's Power Cell and Kathorn's Power Cell to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: ……我们没有能源
tasks.objective_text_zh: 用10个闪电斥候身上的能量给你的作战魔像充电，然后向欧尼瓦营地的勘探员罗卡尔复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Charge your War Golem with the energy from 10 Lightning Sentries and return to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.

extra_objectives.text: Fight Lightning Sentries with Depleted War Golem deployed nearby

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 击败铁领主
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用你的作战魔像去打败铁领主弗雷哈默尔，然后向欧尼瓦营地的托尔玛克复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Using the abilities of your War Golem, defeat Iron Thane Furyhammer, then return to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 监工的制服
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将监工的制服交给欧尼瓦营地的斥候沃塔肯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring an Overseer's Uniform to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 活灵活现
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往丹厄古尔，使用罗卡尔的照相机拍摄8张铁矮人的照片，然后向欧尼瓦营地的斥候沃塔肯复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use Rokar's Camera to record the images of 8 Iron Dwarves in Dun Argol, then return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 洛肯的命令
tasks.objective_text_zh: 伪装成铁符文监工，从洛肯那里截获情报，然后向欧尼瓦营地的斥候沃塔肯复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Disguise yourself as an Iron Rune Overseer, intercept the message from Loken, then report to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.

extra_objectives.text: Intercept the message from Loken

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 以洛肯之名
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与休·格兰斯和加弗洛克谈谈有关洛肯的事情，然后把你的发现汇报给欧尼瓦营地的斥候沃塔肯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Hugh Glass and Gavrock about Loken, then report your findings to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqeah.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 沃达希尔的陨落
tasks.objective_text_zh: 征服堡的风之先知希尔·灰角希望你前往沃达希尔之臂、沃达希尔之心或沃达希尔之泪，从熵能软泥怪那里取回6份软泥怪样本。
tasks.objective_text_en: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to go to Vordrassil's Limb, Vordrassil's Heart or Vordrassil's Tears and obtain 6 Slime Samples from the Entropic Oozes.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 狩猎巨魔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 苏尔肯中士希望你去跟岩石之泉的萨米尔谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Sergeant Thurkin told you to speak to Samir at Granite Springs.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 地下的黑暗
tasks.objective_text_zh: 征服堡的风之先知希尔·灰角希望你前往沃达希尔之臂、沃达希尔之心和沃达希尔之泪，然后在地表之下使用地占师的宝珠。
tasks.objective_text_en: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to go to Vordrassil's Heart, Vordrassil's Tears and Vordrassil's Limb and use the Geomancer's Orb in the depths beneath the surface.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80
